title: SignalTerrain
eyebrow: Waypoint Studio · Understand the world's signals
lead: A coherent intelligence platform for observing, understanding, and connecting signals — Unified Intelligence Objects, living knowledge graph, and calm summaries. Not a news feed, not a SIEM, not IDS/IPS.
mission: Help people answer what changed, why it matters, who is affected, and what should happen next.
principles: Four questions: what changed, why it matters, who is affected, what should happen next
Evidence, context, and historical perspective over fear or hype
Everything important becomes a topic that evolves
Everything is connected — the living knowledge graph accumulates
Events normalize into Unified Intelligence Objects
Relationships connect workspaces — RF, cyber, infrastructure, research, geopolitical
Transparency: confidence, unknowns, sources, Waypoint Analysis
Audio, receivers, and precise locations stay local first
Never fabricate signals, incidents, or threat claims
Educational cyber awareness only — not scanning, offense, SOC, IDS, or IPS
Not another RSS reader — curated understanding over endless feeds

capabilityGroups.title: RF
capabilityGroups.description: Receivers, frequencies, propagation, logging, audio, and signal catalogs — literacy and private tools, not advanced intercept suites.

capabilityGroups.title: Cyber

capabilityGroups.title: Infrastructure
capabilityGroups.description: Routing, cloud, communications, GPS, and disruptions as awareness topics when cited sources exist.

capabilityGroups.title: Research
capabilityGroups.description: Papers, standards, RFCs, government publications, and Waypoint knowledge linked into the topic graph.

dataModel: Topics and relationships are the shared foundation. Receivers, incidents, notes, and audio stay on your device first. Nothing syncs until you choose a path that earns trust. Samples are labeled samples — never presented as live intelligence.
